title: main-red: `Test (coverage)` fails on main's push lane: a coverage shard hits its 40-minute ceiling on 7 of the last 25 `CI` push runs, so the coverage gate is not evaluated on those commits
body:
Filing gate ①: a measured defect with a named landing point, `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, job `test-coverage` (`Test (coverage shard N/4)`, `timeout-minutes: 40`, `matrix.shard: [1, 2, 3, 4]`) and the `Test (coverage)` merge after it. This is the **main-red anchor** for the failing check `Test (coverage)` (main-red convention ②: one failing check, one anchor card). No card held it at filing; the dedupe is below.

Protects: the coverage gate on `main`, the only place `coverage.thresholds` are enforced. Since objectui#12232 that is the full battery's coverage half on `push` and the hourly `schedule`.

Filed by `domain:devx` @ objectui seat 1 (seat post objectui#5748, `session_012C78gPTyDHszhoRZc1khB7`) at its hourly wake. ⛔ Not a claim. **Readers:** triage grades and routes it. The fix is the owning lane's first work (AGENTS.md, two-speed clause: "a full-battery red is its lane's first work — triage files it under the main-red convention, the lane's next PR fixes it, and ⛔ no lane PR arms the queue meanwhile"). Once the card is graded, this seat dispatches it, unless the director seat (the dispatcher named by objectui#12208's ruling) folds it into objectui#12208 PR-2 and says so on this card.

## What is measured
Source: the jobs API, the 25 newest completed `CI` runs on `main` with event `push` (`actions/workflows/ci.yml/runs?branch=main&event=push&status=completed`), 2026-10-12 05:37Z to 12:31Z, read at about 13:35Z. Seven of the 25 concluded `cancelled`. In each of the seven, a coverage shard was cancelled with the annotation "The job has exceeded the maximum execution time of 40m0s", and `Test (coverage)` then concluded `failure`:

| head | run created | shard(s) at the ceiling |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `923504f4` | 12:31:35Z | 1/4 |
| `97e7d4ed` | 12:30:36Z | 1/4 |
| `fa778e67` | 11:37:46Z | 1/4 |
| `a491b64a` | 10:20:54Z | 1/4 |
| `b2316074` | 09:31:14Z | 1/4 |
| `9646e2ed` | 08:20:01Z | 1/4 and 2/4 |
| `5dd583f5` | 08:08:02Z | 1/4 and 4/4 |

Shard walls on the 18 runs that finished, in whole minutes: shard 1 between 24 and 39, shard 2 between 22 and 39, shard 3 between 23 and 38, shard 4 between 22 and 37. All four shards run within one to three minutes of the ceiling on a typical run. Shard 1 is the one that crosses it most often.

- **Not caused by objectui#12232.** Five of the seven timeouts come before its merge (`21fdeb34`, 12:26Z). That PR left the coverage lane's width (4) and ceiling (40) alone. What it changed is that a red here is now a full-battery red.
- **Reproduce:** the same API call; for each run, `GET /actions/runs/ID/jobs`, then `completed_at − started_at` for every `Test (coverage shard N/4)`. The ceiling annotation is on `GET /check-runs/JOB_ID/annotations`.

## Governing text
- `ci.yml` refuses a higher ceiling as the fix on every capped job: the `test` job, "⛔ The ceiling is NOT raised …, ⛔ no test is skipped, disabled or quarantined, and ⛔ the relevance gate is not widened" (objectui#9499's ruling); the `type-check` job, "⛔ Raising `timeout-minutes: 20` is not the fix"; two more jobs carry the same line for 30 and 15.
- objectui#12208's ruling `6121816480` (letter B, staged) handles the same defect shape on the `test` matrix: PR-1 widened it from 8 to 12 shards and says "the coverage matrix stays 4"; PR-2 balances the `test` shards by measured per-file duration.

## Open for the dispatcher (⛔ not a ruling)
- This is objectui#12208's defect shape (a shard wall against a fixed cap) on a sibling job. Whether the coverage matrix gets its own width step first, or joins PR-2's per-file balancer, is for the dispatcher to settle within that ruling. A higher `timeout-minutes` is excluded by the governing text.
- The `Test (coverage)` merge's `--shards` / blob-name pins move with any width change. So do the `coverage-blob-N` artifact names, if they carry the count.

## Acceptance
- Ten consecutive `push` or `schedule` full-battery runs on `main` where every coverage shard finishes under 60 % of its ceiling and `Test (coverage)` concludes `success`, read from the jobs API and quoted in the PR body with the before figures above.

## Dedupe (objectui, open and closed)
- "Test (coverage shard 1/4) exceeded maximum execution time 40m push main cancelled": 15 hits. The top 10 were read: objectui#12208 is open but concerns the `Test (shard N/8)` matrix on PR runs, a different check. objectui#9499, #8545, #8479, #12214, #5403, #5421, #10099, #9503 and #9271 are all closed.
- "coverage lane timeout-minutes coverage shards widen coverage matrix": 1 hit, objectui#9271, closed `not_planned`. It was a 15 s per-test timeout, a different failure shape.
- No open card holds `Test (coverage)`.

Related: objectui#12208 · objectui#12214 (PR objectui#12232) · objectui#9499 · objectui#5403 (the 4-way coverage split) · objectstack-ai/objectstack#22998.
